title: Pro-p Sylow — narrow axiom-discharge targets adjacent to completed OQ-02

problemStatement.formal: \text{Identify narrow S2 targets adjacent to the completed sibling slug }\texttt{sylow-theorems-oq-02}\text{ (5 axioms + 1 sorry in }\texttt{SylowTheoremOQ02.lean}\text{); discharge two of the five axioms and the one sorry without re-attempting the deep inverse-limit construction.}
problemStatement.plain: sylow-theorems-oq-03 ('pro-p Sylow theorem, recovered as inverse limit of finite-group Sylow theorems') is a near-duplicate of the completed sibling sylow-theorems-oq-02 ('Pro-p Sylow Theory for Profinite Groups'). Rather than re-attempt the conjecture, audit the OQ-02 file (393 lines, 5 axioms + 1 sorry) and propose 2-3 narrow adjacent S2 targets that surgically discharge the easy axioms without the deep inverse-limit construction. S1 OBSERVE shortlists three candidates: (A) project_pgroup axiom via existing proP_subgroup_card_ppow ~50 LOC; (B) inter_trivial axiom via coprime-order in finite quotients ~25 LOC; (C) normal_of_unique sorry via existing isProP_conj_map ~40 LOC.
whyMatters: Axiom integrity: dropping OQ-02's axiom count from 5 to 3 strengthens the gallery claim without changing main-theorem signatures.
Duplicate-detection pattern: follows the memory-recorded approach for completed-sibling slugs (researcher-12 PR #18235, 2026-05-12).
OQ-02's own nextSteps explicitly list normal_of_unique as a target; OQ-03 picks it up.

open: A: discharge sylowProP_projects_pgroup axiom (line 134 of OQ-02) using proP_subgroup_card_ppow (line 332, already proven) — ~50 LOC.
B: discharge sylowProP_inter_trivial axiom (line 142) via coprime-order in finite quotients — ~25 LOC, conditional on IsProfiniteGroup exposing totally-disconnected.
C: discharge sylowProP_normal_of_unique sorry (line 285) using isProP_conj_map (line 226) — ~40 LOC.
knownResults.goal: Ship proofs/Proofs/SylowTheoremOQ03.lean (~50 LOC, 0 sorries) discharging Candidate A; update OQ-02's file to delete the axiom and replace uses. Net: OQ-02 axiom count drops from 5 to 4 with no main-theorem signature changes.

knowledge.progressSummary: S1 OBSERVE doc-only: detected duplication with completed sibling sylow-theorems-oq-02; audited OQ-02's actual open items (5 axioms + 1 sorry at lines 108/119/126/134/142/285 of SylowTheoremOQ02.lean); classified each by S2-addressability into deep (existence, conjugacy — needs inverse-limit), moderate (frattini — needs existence+conjugacy), and surgical (projects_pgroup, inter_trivial, normal_of_unique). insights: OQ-02's 5 axioms cleanly split into deep (existence, conjugacy — inverse-limit) and surgical (projects_pgroup, inter_trivial — finite-quotient arguments).
frattini_profinite is derivable from existence + conjugacy + finite Frattini; it is NOT independent — discharging it after the two deep ones is mechanical.
The 1 sorry (normal_of_unique) is in OQ-02's own nextSteps and is the easiest single-iteration win for OQ-03.
Candidate A's discharge uses an already-proven local lemma (proP_subgroup_card_ppow at line 332) — no new Mathlib lemmas required.
Candidate B is conditional on IsProfiniteGroup's API; recommended order is A → C → B.
mathlibGaps: Mathlib has no ProfiniteGroup class (consistent with OQ-02's note); the local IsProfiniteGroup is the working substitute.
Mathlib has no pro-p group type; the local IsProP class is the working substitute.
Both gaps are out of scope for OQ-03 (OQ-02 already records them).
